name: Ohio Building (1896, George S. Mills), 420 Madison Ave
refs: refs/w429955308/00 (Ohio Building, Toledo, Ohio, June 2022, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Twelve-storey Chicago-school tower in white glazed terracotta: two-storey base with frieze, a grid of paired windows between piers, a terracotta frieze and deep cornice under a steep green copper hipped roof with a flagpole.
